name: Bajo las estrellas
source:
You are immortal. More or less.  

The city darkens for the umpteenth time in your existence. A mystery roams the streets, leaving a trail of blood in its wake. Will you go in search of it or take another path?

Choose what to do, where to go, who to talk to and what to say, but remember that every decision has consequences. Will you see nightfall again?

[Translated from [url=https://orangedaisy.itch.io/bajo-las-estrellas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是不朽的。或多或少。

这座城市在你存在以来无数次变暗。一个谜团在街道上徘徊，留下了血迹。你会去寻找它还是走另一条路？

选择要做什么、去哪里、与谁交谈以及说什么，但请记住，每个决定都会产生后果。你会再次看到夜幕降临吗？

[翻译自[url=https://orangedaisy.itch.io/bajo-las-estrellas]itch.io[/url]]
